sloka: रथान् मण्डल चक्रामः च योजयित्वा परः शतम् ।उष्ट्र गो अश्व खरैः भृत्या भरतम् यान्तम् अन्वयुः ॥२-७०-२९॥
transliteration: rathān maṇḍala cakrāmaḥ ca yojayitvā paraḥ śatam ।uṣṭra go aśva kharaiḥ bhṛtyā bharatam yāntam anvayuḥ ॥2-70-29॥

translations.english: And the servants harnessing more than a hundred chariots of wellrounded wheels and also camels, oxen and horses followed Bharata who started off.
